_comment: Clarivate's mapping from Web of Science Subject Categories to Research Areas,
read off actual records rather than reconstructed. Both schemes appear in the
Categories/Classification block of every Core Collection full record, so a
single record shows the mapping for each of its categories at once.
Most pairs are name-identical. The seven that are not were each confirmed
against a named record — see verifiedFrom. Nothing here is inferred.
Note the record spelling "Science & Technology - Other Topics" carries a
hyphen that Clarivate's own help page omits. The record wins.
Research Areas are the broader scheme: about 150 against roughly 250
categories, and shared across every WoS database rather than only the Core
Collection. That second property is why the Journal of Asian Sociology paper
has a Research Area (Sociology, from KCI) and no category at all — its entry
